issue.title: www.youtube.com

labels.name: T: Incorrect Blocking
labels.description: Website or app not working properly due to filtering

labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.title: Counterfeit/scam site impersonating Luhxe: luhxe.shop
issue.body:
luhxe.shop is a counterfeit storefront impersonating the brand Luhxe (registered US trademark LUHXE, Reg. No. 7,656,203; official site https://luhxe.com). It uses the LUHXE mark in the domain and sells fake "Luhxe" bags, taking payment for goods that are not Luhxe's (trademark counterfeiting + non-delivery fraud). Please add https://luhxe.shop to the scam/phishing blocklist so browsers warn users.

Legitimate brand: https://luhxe.com
Counterfeit: https://luhxe.shop

issue.title: Duplicate rules in ChineseFilter (specific.txt)
issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer;
- [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed;
- [x] This is not an ad/bug report.

### Problem description

There are multiple duplicate rules in the filters.

`#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open')`

```
[$domain=/^vidhub\d+\.(cc\|top)$/]##.player-info div[class]:has(> div[class][style] > img[onclick^="window.open"]:first-child + span[style]:last-child)
vidhub2.top,vidhub3.top,vidhub4.cc,vidhub.me,vidhub.tv##.player-info div[class]:has(> div[class][style] > img[onclick^="window.open"]:first-child + span[style]:last-child) 
```

```
8727ck.cc,8726ck.cc##.stui-vodlist > li:has(> div.stui-vodlist__box > a[href][target="_blank"])
[$domain=/87\d{2}ck\.cc/]##.stui-vodlist > li:has(> div.stui-vodlist__box > a[href][target="_blank"])
```

```
||bz*.net/js/cdn.js
||bz88888.net/js/cdn.js
```



### Proposed solution

Merge or remove rules if possible.

### Additional information

_No response_

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

@ghajini it's reproducible on iOS27, make sure you're on the latest iOS. I've prepared a PR with Claude Code. Currently on my iPhone using the following three user rules solves the issue:

```
dir.bg#@#amp-ad-exit + div[class*=" "]:has(+ div[aria-hidden="true"] + amp-pixel + amp-pixel)
dir.bg#@#amp-ad-exit + div[class*=" "]:has(+ div[aria-hidden="true"] + amp-pixel + div[style^="bottom:0;right:0;width"])
dir.bg#@#amp-ad-exit + div[class*=" "]:has(+ div[aria-hidden="true"] + div[style^="bottom:0;right:0;width"])
```

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

# Comment
On this site's anti-adblock detection is triggered when the **Japanese filter (full version)** is enabled. The **optimized version of the same filter does not reproduce the issue**.

 - Full: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt
 - Optimized: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7_optimized.txt

 ## Reproduction Results
 
 | Filters enabled | Result |
 |---|---|
 | Japanese (full) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Japanese (optimized) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Base + Japanese (full) | Anti-adblock **IS shown** (NG) |
 | Base + Japanese (optimized) | Normal (OK) |
 | Base only | Normal (OK) |
 

 ## Note on the optimized filter as a workaround
 
 Switching to the optimized filter is not a viable workaround here. I browse a wide range of sites as part of my work, and the optimized list drops rules that the full list needs to cover them. Falling back to the optimized list and then reporting each missed site individually would defeat the purpose of the optimization, so I would like the full list itself to be fixed.
 
 ## Steps Already Tried (none resolved the issue)
 
 - Updated the filter rules to the latest version
 - Updated the AdGuard iOS app to the latest version
 - Restarted the device
 - Cleared Safari's cache
 - Disabled all content blockers in Safari settings and enabled them again
 - Restarted Safari
 - Restarted AdGuard
 - Checked for filter updates in AdGuard (wait 1 min)
 
 ## Additional Information
 
 - The only Safari extension enabled is AdGuard, so interference from other extensions can be ruled out.
 - Switching between the full and optimized lists was done with a full filter update in between.
 - I believe this is the same as or similar to issue #241409.
 
 

## Screenshots
<details><summary>Screenshot 1:</summary>

![](https://i.postimg.cc/bvCfNtdc/image.png)

</details>

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

### Add your comment and screenshots

# Comment
On this site's anti-adblock detection is triggered when the **Japanese filter (full version)** is enabled. The **optimized version of the same filter does not reproduce the issue**.

 - Full: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt
 - Optimized: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7_optimized.txt

 ## Reproduction Results
 
 | Filters enabled | Result |
 |---|---|
 | Japanese (full) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Japanese (optimized) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Base + Japanese (full) | Anti-adblock **IS shown** (NG) |
 | Base + Japanese (optimized) | Normal (OK) |
 | Base only | Normal (OK) |
 

 ## Note on the optimized filter as a workaround
 
 Switching to the optimized filter is not a viable workaround here. I browse a wide range of sites as part of my work, and the optimized list drops rules that the full list needs to cover them. Falling back to the optimized list and then reporting each missed site individually would defeat the purpose of the optimization, so I would like the full list itself to be fixed.
 
 ## Steps Already Tried (none resolved the issue)
 
 - Updated the filter rules to the latest version
 - Updated the AdGuard iOS app to the latest version
 - Restarted the device
 - Cleared Safari's cache
 - Disabled all content blockers in Safari settings and enabled them again
 - Restarted Safari
 - Restarted AdGuard
 - Checked for filter updates in AdGuard (wait 1 min)
 
 ## Additional Information
 
 - The only Safari extension enabled is AdGuard, so interference from other extensions can be ruled out.
 - Switching between the full and optimized lists was done with a full filter update in between.
 - I believe this is the same as or similar to issue #241409.

</details>

issue.title: Fix #242392 dir.bg
issue.body:
Fixes #242392

***Description***:
* **Current behaviour**: On iOS 27, `https://dir.bg/` (mobile layout) is scrollable for about a second after loading, then freezes for ~10 seconds: no scrolling, links not clickable. Scrolling right away only reveals a blank, unpainted area. Disabling only AdGuard Base filter fixes it.

* **Expected behaviour**: The page scrolls and responds immediately.

***Root cause***:
The freeze is caused by three generic content-blocker-only rules in `BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt` (AdShield / html-load block):

```
##amp-ad-exit + div[class*=" "]:has(+ div[aria-hidden="true"] + amp-pixel + amp-pixel)
##amp-ad-exit + div[class*=" "]:has(+ div[aria-hidden="true"] + amp-pixel + div[style^="bottom:0;right:0;width"])
##amp-ad-exit + div[class*=" "]:has(+ div[aria-hidden="true"] + div[style^="bottom:0;right:0;width"])
```

Safari evaluates these natively. Their subject (`div[class*=" "]`) matches most `div`s, and the sibling `:has(+ …)` has to be re-checked whenever siblings change. The dir.bg homepage is very large (~2.3 MB HTML, ~34k elements) and changes a lot right after load, so on iOS 27 this ties up the main thread for ~10 s. dir.bg has no `amp-ad-exit` / AdShield markup, so these rules never match anything there.

The reporter only started seeing this after upgrading to iOS 27. It doesn't reproduce with AdGuard for Safari on macOS or in Chromium-based browsers. That suggests a WebKit regression in sibling `:has()` invalidation, which could affect other large pages too. It may be worth reviewing these generic rules for content blockers.

***Rules added*** (`BaseFilter/sections/allowlist.txt`, limited to the same platforms as the original rules):

```
dir.bg#@#amp-ad-exit + div[class*=" "]:has(+ div[aria-hidden="true"] + amp-pixel + amp-pixel)
dir.bg#@#amp-ad-exit + div[class*=" "]:has(+ div[aria-hidden="true"] + amp-pixel + div[style^="bottom:0;right:0;width"])
dir.bg#@#amp-ad-exit + div[class*=" "]:has(+ div[aria-hidden="true"] + div[style^="bottom:0;right:0;width"])
```

The existing `dir.bg##.lenta-btn` / `dir.bg##.banner` rules are unchanged.

***How it was tested*** (bisected on the device with user rules, reloading dir.bg in a fresh tab each time):
1. Advanced protection off: still freezes, so the cause is in the Safari content blocker, not scriptlets.
2. `@@||dir.bg^$elemhide`: no freeze, so the cause is cosmetic.
3. `@@||dir.bg^$generichide`: no freeze, so the cause is a generic cosmetic rule.
4. Only 3 generic selectors out of ~14k match anything on dir.bg (empty `div-gpt-ad-*` slots; GPT itself is blocked by `||g.doubleclick.net^`), so the suspect was expensive selectors rather than matched elements.
5. Exceptions for all 11 generic `:has()` rules: no freeze. The two `head:has(...)` rules alone: still freezes. `button[class]:has(+ …)` alone: still freezes. The three `amp-ad-exit + div[class*=" "]:has(+ …)` rules: no freeze.
6. Final check with only the three exceptions from this PR as user rules: no freeze.

***System configuration***

Information                            | Value
---                                    | ---
Operating system:                      | iOS
Operating system version (Android/iOS) | 27
Browser:                               | Safari
AdGuard version:                       | 4.5.22
Filters enabled:                       | AdGuard Base filter (+ defaults)
Advanced protection                    | On (freeze also occurs with it off)

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

issue.body:
# Creating the pull request

> Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed\
> If the related issue does not exist in our repository, please create it before making pull request\
> It is highly recommended to use our [Web Reporting Tool](https://kb.adguard.com/technical-support/reporting-tool) instead of creating an issue on GitHub directly\
> Please note, that we verify every pull request manually, so it may take time to apply it

## Prerequisites

### To avoid invalid pull requests, please check and confirm following terms

- [x] This is not an ad/bug report;
- [x] My code follows the [guidelines](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [syntax](https://kb.adguard.com/general/how-to-create-your-own-ad-filters) of this project;
- [x] I have performed a self-review of my own changes;
- [x] My changes do not break web sites, apps and files structure.

## What problem does the pull request fix?

These appear twice in the list

### If the problem does not fall under any category that is listed here, please write a comment below in corresponding section

- [ ] Missed ads or ad leftovers;
- [ ] Website or app doesn't work properly;
- [ ] AdGuard gets detected on a website;
- [ ] Missed analytics or tracker;
- [ ] Social media buttons — share, like, tweet, etc;
- [ ] Annoyances — pop-ups, cookie warnings, etc;
- [x] Filters maintenance.

## What issue is being fixed?

```
@@||airliners.de^$generichide
@@||brigitte.de^$generichide
@@||cdn.static-fra.de/*/adcontrol.min.js$domain=rtl.de
@@||cdntrf.com/tarnkappe-info.js$domain=tarnkappe.info
@@||gamestar.de^$generichide
@@||menshealth.de^$generichide
@@||motorsport-total.com^$generichide
@@||promobil.de^$generichide
@@||runnersworld.de^$generichide
@@||sat1.de^$generichide
@@||securepubads.g.doubleclick.net/gpt/pubads_impl_*.js$domain=heise.de
```

### Terms

- [x] By submitting this issue, I agree that pull request does not contain private info and all conditions are met
